_about: Short learner glosses for HSK words: the headline shown instead of CC-CEDICT's first usable sense, which is often not the sense a learner meets first. Each gloss is tied to the main reading it was written for ('pinyin', tone-marked, syllables space-separated) and replaces only the headline; all CC-CEDICT senses and the other readings stay visible under it. Entries are written from the HSK-list English and every CC-CEDICT reading and sense of the word, checked against CC-CEDICT by an independent second pass and by tools/check_learner_glosses.py, and spot-checked by hand. They paraphrase CC-CEDICT senses and are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 like CC-CEDICT (see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). Workflow: tools/README.md.
